phase9_8_verdict_logic.rule: final_verdict PASS if active_windows >= 4 AND integrity.status == PASS
phase9_8_verdict_logic.note: Phase 9.8 has no overfitting_risk_decreased or robustness_improved checks

phase9_9_intent.docstring: Check Phase 9.9 acceptance vs Phase 9.8 baseline
phase9_9_intent.pattern: Sequential phase improvement gate — candidate must beat Phase 9.8 baseline on multiple axes

origin.conclusion: overfitting_risk_decreased was authored in Phase 9.9 evaluate_acceptance to require strict ordinal improvement over the Phase 9.8 baseline risk label. It was not copied from Phase 9.8 code (which lacks acceptance checks), but inherits the sequential baseline-beating pattern used across Phase 9.9 acceptance rules.
